test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 09 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Choose the option that is the correct passive form of the sentence.**

The culture was losing its meaning.

options.text: The meaning of the culture was lost.
The meaning of the culture was being lost.
The meaning of the culture will lost.

solution:
The correct passive form of the sentence is:** The meaning of the culture was being lost.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• To convert an active voice sentence to passive voice
